candidates.title: build-receipt-capture
candidates.description: Photograph a receipt and store it against an expense.
candidates.rationale: The PRODUCT's own scope (PS-001), decomposed once from concept.json.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: A user can photograph a receipt and see it attached to the expense.

assumptions.statement: the device camera API returns a usable image on the target OS versions

candidates.verification_plan: Photograph a real receipt on a real device and confirm it renders on the expense.

candidates.title: build-expense-export
candidates.description: Export a date range of expenses as a file the finance team can import.
candidates.rationale: The PRODUCT's own scope (PS-002), decomposed once from concept.json.
candidates.user_visible_outcome: A user can download a month of expenses and open it in their accounting tool.

assumptions.statement: the accounting tool accepts the export format without a manual mapping step

candidates.verification_plan: Export a real month and import it into a real accounting tool sandbox.
